findings: Independently read History, Directors chapters and grepped whole text for Pre-IPO, nominate/appoint, observer, special rights. No Pre-IPO section; seven directors (4 exec, 3 INED) with no investor link. Only affirmative statement found is the waiver condition (pdf p068, printed 59) that Permitted Existing Shareholders (minority holders eligible for H-share placing) have no power to appoint Directors or other special rights - limited to that subset and framed as a waiver condition, so not a general statement that no pre-IPO investor holds/nominates a seat. No explicit statement that no pre-IPO investments exist. Candidate quotes verified verbatim, page mapping correct. Agree candidate: absence of evidence is not 0.
residual_uncertainty: Leaning 0 in substance (no linked director, A+H issuer with no H-share pre-IPO round) but the schema requires explicit affirmative evidence; a reviewer could accept 0 on the basis of the p068 waiver condition plus roster, but that is a stretch.
